page_title: PAR 1-4 JUV | Parma v Juventus 01/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Parma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

90+3' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Michele Di Gregorio stops the ball from going inside right post. The ball is out of play. Parma will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+3' Celebrations are cut short for Juventus as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
90+3' The Juventus players halt their celebrations as referee Francesco Fourneau makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
90+1' Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Lois Openda (Juventus) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom left corner. Good team effort!
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' Mandela Keita (Parma) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
86' Francesco Fourneau shows a yellow card to Alessandro Circati (Parma) for his blatant foul.
85' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends his bullet header just wide of the right post.
83' Edoardo Corvi blocks Filip Kostic (Juventus)'s effort from the edge of the box.
81' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jonathan David walks off the pitch to be replaced by Lois Openda (Juventus).
78' A spell of possession for Parma in an attempt to control the game.

76' What an opportunity! Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the left post.
75' Here is a change. Jacob Ondrejka is going off and Carlos Cuesta gives the last tactical orders to Nesta Elphege (Parma).
74' Carlos Cuesta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nahuel Estevez (Parma) replacing Adrian Bernabe Garcia.
74' Today's match ends for Weston McKennie who will be replaced by Juan Cabal (Juventus).
73' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
71' The current number of corner kicks is 4:3.
69' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
68' Juventus keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
66' Luciano Spalletti decides to make a substitution. Bremer will be replaced by Federico Gatti (Juventus).
65' Substitution. Oliver Sorensen (Parma) replaces Hans Nicolussi Caviglia.
65' Filip Kostic (Juventus) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Francisco Conceicao.
64' 1 - 4 Goal! The rebound fell to Jonathan David (Juventus) and he fired home from close range. The score is 1:4.
63' Juventus hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
61' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 6:11.

59' Weston McKennie (Juventus) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
57' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Francesco Fourneau signals that the goal stands! The Juventus players celebrate.
56' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Juventus players aren’t happy.
54' 1 - 3 Bremer (Juventus) has a great chance inside the box and puts the ball into the back of the net.
53' Alessandro Circati (Parma) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul.
51' 1 - 2 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it under his own crossbar.
49' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

48' Juventus are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
46' Luciano Spalletti has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Fabio Miretti comes on the pitch for Kenan Yildiz (Juventus).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Gaetano Oristanio (Parma) is replaced by Sascha Britschgi.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
42' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
39' Juventus are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
37' 0 - 2 Weston McKennie (Juventus) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and with a precise low drive puts the ball into the bottom right corner.
34' The free kick from long range, taken by Parma, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
31' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Parma.
30' Total attempts – 2:5.
28' A cross from Emanuele Valeri (Parma) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
26' Weston McKennie (Juventus) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.

25' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
24' Bremer (Juventus) has tested the patience of referee Francesco Fourneau and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
22' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
21' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
20' Jonathan David (Juventus) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
19' Parma are seeing far more of the ball now.
17' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) was quite harsh and Francesco Fourneau didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
15' 0 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Bremer (Juventus) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the left side of the goal. He makes it 0:1.
15' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
13' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
12' Francesco Fourneau blows for a foul after Enrico Delprato (Parma) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
10' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Francisco Conceicao (Juventus).
8' Weston McKennie (Juventus) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
6' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the crossbar to safety.
4' Juventus are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
2' Juventus have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

2' This was a piece of cake for Edoardo Corvi. Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper. Juventus earn a corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
Juventus will kick-off.
Francesco Fourneau will supervise the game today.
